reason: B is preferable because its graded Ti series directly tests a solid-solution/local-bonding ductilization window without depending on A’s physically dubious claim that Ti-rich precipitates lower the Peierls barrier; A also contradicts itself by requiring both a single-phase BCC alloy and a Ti-rich second phase, while its cited study observed no precipitates.
